serializedCodeBeforeWorker.reason: Cold code compilation serialized before Worker construction; cold regression motivated startup overlap.

stlTupleMicrobenchmark.method: Four warmup pairs, twelve alternating measured pairs; exact output signatures checked for every pair. Offline CPU diagnostic, not browser acceptance.

reproducer.usage: Extract modules and bench.mjs together under web-console/test-results and run node bench.mjs with installed lockfile dependencies. Absolute dependency imports are normalized to bare package names; hashes retain the original captured files. Infinity disables only the optional benchmark deadline so both complete outputs can be compared.

memoryPhaseSamples.method: Bounded diagnostic worker Runtime.getHeapUsage checkpoints and observed exported WASM Memory.buffer sizes. Debugger overhead changes timings. Heap/backing/WASM fields can overlap and must not be added. Committed WASM bytes are not residency, RSS, virtual reservation, or unobserved peak.
memoryPhaseSamples.sourceCheckpoint: Before main-thread code sharing; fresh per-Worker WASM memories. Final code-only sharing is independently checked by actual lifecycle tests, not asserted to have the identical sampled whole-process footprint.

limitations: queryObjects/GC probe crashed its page and produced no usable memory result.
Short-lived STL/outline target attachment can end before setup; no memory values are inferred for unobserved phases.
Two CAD workers started 0.4ms apart and their observed lifetimes overlap about481ms. Each sampled WASM memory committed29949952bytes.
memoryPhaseSamples.captureHeaderCorrection: The retained one-owner header still mentions GC from the earlier script. No queryObjects or forced GC was requested in the retained bounded samples. The discarded queryObjects probe crashed and yielded no retained memory measurements.

cpuDiagnostic.method: Separate production-bundle diagnostic Chrome trace. Self CPU time estimates sum trace timeDeltas by sampled leaf. Timing perturbed by profiling; not acceptance latency. (program), (idle), GC, and unresolved node IDs are retained separately; native WASM compiler/GPU driver time may be outside sampled JS stacks. No peak/RSS inference.

codeLifecycle.title: cancelled CAD code wait retires its idle Worker and the retained copy reuses only compiled code

evidence.method: Lifecycle observation; reopen includes outline completion and uses the original elapsed action harness, not the cold acceptance endpoint.

codeLifecycle.title: two actual split CAD owners share code and allocate fresh import Workers after retirement

evidence.method: Two genuine split CAD bodies; fresh Workers and instances on every reveal. Only compiled immutable code is shared. Reopen elapsed includes outline completion and is not cold acceptance latency.

visualAndCommands.method: Diagnostic same pinned browser/viewport/default outlines/camera. Actual WEBGL_multi_draw calls tracked; snapshots after default outline completion. First actual model GPU+rAF remains separate from outline state readiness; no physical display claim.

validation.functional: Original37-case production fixture/application run had33passes. Three setup errors used preview5273 without matching preview-port env; startup targeted5173 and origin-bound file observations returned400. Corrected-port seven-case run passed real delivery+Workbench CAD, startup deferral and four hover cases. Revised auxiliary en/zh then passed with cleared composer and page-before-host teardown.
validation.shader: Six generated/authored thin-occlusion pixel cases at scales1e-6,1,1e6 passed. Default outline restoration/no-idle, curved silhouettes, both two-pane resource cases, navigation and malformed/source-ownership cases passed.
failuresRetained: Initial sandbox listener EPERM required local-listener escalation.
Initial temporary .ts Vite config was treated as CJS; .mts fixed config loading.
A combined build during an incomplete importer edit failed CAD and was excluded.
Auxiliary browser assertions passed but live proxy polling raced closed Host cleanup; page.close before fixture.stop fixed teardown without retries.
The earlier visual Front capture differed in1956pixels with maxchannel delta10; repeated complete captures including the final adopted scene were identical.
validation.rawEvidenceChecks: Recomputed every raw orbit/pan nearest-rank P95 from100samples, verified GPU-ready precedes next-rAF opportunity, and confirmed baseline/final model counts, renderer, antialiasing, DPR and target objects match.
validation.exactFinalApplication: After the final overlap application production build, both native-authorized delivery-sidebar and Workbench CAD browser cases passed (2/2,18.5s) with consistent preview5273/fixture5274 environment. They cover parts, short/narrow viewports, localized dark layout, retained reopening and source actions.

codeLifecycleCounterMeaning: code.workers/modules are cumulative Worker constructions / Module posts; retirement.workers is live ownership. Counts4→6 mean two fresh constructions after zero live owners, not six concurrent workers.
cpuDiagnosticSourceCheckpoint: Separate surface-only experiment bundle after scalar STL indexing, before packed outline adoption and main code sharing. CPU stacks explain operations; profiler timings are not final acceptance.
